insecure.description: Insecure connection does not verify MikroTik's TLS certificate

tls.description: Whether to use TLS when connecting to MikroTik or not

as.description: The 32-bit BGP autonomous system number. Must be a value within 0 to 4294967295.

client_to_client_reflection.description: In case this instance is a route reflector: whether to redistribute routes learned from one routing reflection client to other clients. Default: `true`.

cluster_id.description: In case this instance is a route reflector: cluster ID of the router reflector cluster this instance belongs to. Default: `""`.

comment.description: The comment of the BGP instance to be created. Default: `""`.

confederation.description: In case of BGP confederations: autonomous system number that identifies the [local] confederation as a whole. Default: `0`.

confederation_peers.description: List of AS numbers internal to the [local] confederation. For example: `10,20,30-50`. Default: `""`.

ignore_as_path_len.description: Whether to ignore AS_PATH attribute in BGP route selection algorithm. Default: `false`.

name.description: The name of the BGP instance.

out_filter.description: Output routing filter chain used by all BGP peers belonging to this instance. Default: `""`.

redistribute_connected.description: If enabled, this BGP instance will redistribute the information about connected routes. Default: `false`.

redistribute_ospf.description: If enabled, this BGP instance will redistribute the information about routes learned by OSPF. Default: `false`.

redistribute_other_bgp.description: If enabled, this BGP instance will redistribute the information about routes learned by other BGP instances. Default: `false`.

redistribute_rip.description: If enabled, this BGP instance will redistribute the information about routes learned by RIP. Default: `false`.

redistribute_static.description: If enabled, the router will redistribute the information about static routes added to its routing database. Default: `false`.

router_id.description: BGP Router ID (for this instance). If set to 0.0.0.0, BGP will use one of router's IP addresses.

routing_table.description: Name of routing table this BGP instance operates on.  Default: `""`.

block.description: Creates a Mikrotik BGP Instance.

address_families.description: The list of address families about which this peer will exchange routing information. Default: `ip`.

allow_as_in.description: How many times to allow own AS number in AS-PATH, before discarding a prefix.

as_override.description: If set, then all instances of remote peer's AS number in BGP AS PATH attribute are replaced with local AS number before sending route update to that peer. Default: `false`.

comment.description: The comment of the BGP peer to be created.

default_originate.description: The comment of the BGP peer to be created. Default: `never`.

hold_time.description: Specifies the BGP Hold Time value to use when negotiating with peer Default: `3m`.

in_filter.description: The name of the routing filter chain that is applied to the incoming routing information.

instance.description: The name of the instance this peer belongs to. See Mikrotik bgp instance resource. Default: `default`.

max_prefix_limit.description: Maximum number of prefixes to accept from a specific peer.

max_prefix_restart_time.description: Minimum time interval after which peers can reestablish BGP session.

multihop.description: Specifies whether the remote peer is more than one hop away.

name.description: The name of the BGP peer.

nexthop_choice.description: Affects the outgoing NEXT_HOP attribute selection, either: 'default', 'force-self', or 'propagate' Default: `default`.

out_filter.description: The name of the routing filter chain that is applied to the outgoing routing information.

passive.description: Name of the routing filter chain that is applied to the outgoing routing information. Default: `false`.

remote_address.description: The address of the remote peer

remote_as.description: The 32-bit AS number of the remote peer.

remote_port.description: Remote peers port to establish tcp session.

remove_private_as.description: If set, then BGP AS-PATH attribute is removed before sending out route update if attribute contains only private AS numbers.

route_reflect.description: Specifies whether this peer is route reflection client.

tcp_md5_key.description: Key used to authenticate the connection with TCP MD5 signature as described in RFC 2385.

ttl.description: Time To Live, the hop limit for TCP connection. This is a `string` field that can be 'default' or '0'-'255'. Default: `default`.

update_source.description: If address is specified, this address is used as the source address of the outgoing TCP connection.

use_bfd.description: Whether to use BFD protocol for fast state detection.

block.description: Creates a MikroTik BGP Peer.

fast_forward.description: Special and faster case of FastPath which works only on bridges with 2 interfaces (enabled by default only for new bridges). Default: `true`.

vlan_filtering.description: Globally enables or disables VLAN functionality for bridge.

block.description: Manages a bridge resource on remote MikroTik device.

bridge.description: The bridge interface the respective interface is grouped in.

pvid.description: Port VLAN ID (pvid) specifies which VLAN the untagged ingress traffic is assigned to. This property only has effect when vlan-filtering is set to yes.

block.description: Manages ports in bridge associations.

bridge.description: The bridge interface which the respective VLAN entry is intended for.

id.description: A unique ID for this resource.

tagged.description: Interface list with a VLAN tag adding action in egress.

untagged.description: Interface list with a VLAN tag removing action in egress.

vlan_ids.description: The list of VLAN IDs for certain port configuration. Ranges are not supported yet.

block.description: Creates a MikroTik BridgeVlan.

address.description: The IP address of the DHCP lease to be created.

blocked.description: Whether to block access for this DHCP client (true|false). Default: `false`.

comment.description: The comment of the DHCP lease to be created.

dynamic.description: Whether the dhcp lease is static or dynamic. Dynamic leases are not guaranteed to continue to be assigned to that specific device. Defaults to false.

macaddress.description: The MAC addreess of the DHCP lease to be created.

block.description: Creates a DHCP lease on the MikroTik device.

add_arp.description: Whether to add dynamic ARP entry. If set to no either ARP mode should be enabled on that interface or static ARP entries should be administratively defined.

address_pool.description: IP pool, from which to take IP addresses for the clients. If set to static-only, then only the clients that have a static lease (added in lease submenu) will be allowed. Default: `static-only`.

authoritative.description: Option changes the way how server responds to DHCP requests. Default: `yes`.

disabled.description: Disable this DHCP server instance. Default: `true`.

interface.description: Interface on which server will be running. Default: `*0`.

lease_script.description: Script that will be executed after lease is assigned or de-assigned. Internal "global" variables that can be used in the script.

block.description: Manages a DHCP server resource within MikroTik device.

address.description: The network DHCP server(s) will lease addresses from.

dns_server.description: The DHCP client will use these as the default DNS servers.

gateway.description: The default gateway to be used by DHCP Client. Default: `0.0.0.0`.

netmask.description: The actual network mask to be used by DHCP client. If set to '0' - netmask from network address will be used.

block.description: Manages a DHCP network resource within Mikrotik device.

address.description: The A record to be returend from the DNS hostname.

comment.description: The comment text associated with the DNS record.

name.description: The name of the DNS hostname to be created.

ttl.description: The ttl of the DNS record.

block.description: Creates a DNS record on the MikroTik device.

action.description: Action to take if packet is matched by the rule. Default: `accept`.

chain.description: Specifies to which chain rule will be added. If the input does not match the name of an already defined chain, a new chain will be created.

connection_state.description: Interprets the connection tracking analysis data for a particular packet.

dst_port.description: List of destination port numbers or port number ranges.

in_interface.description: Interface the packet has entered the router.

in_interface_list.description: Set of interfaces defined in interface list. Works the same as in-interface.

out_interface_list.description: Set of interfaces defined in interface list. Works the same as out-interface.

protocol.description: Matches particular IP protocol specified by protocol name or number. Default: `tcp`.

comment.description: Comment associated with interface wireguard. Default: `""`.

disabled.description: Boolean for whether or not the interface wireguard is disabled. Default: `false`.

id.description: Identifier of this resource assigned by RouterOS

listen_port.description: Port for WireGuard service to listen on for incoming sessions. Default: `13231`.

private_key.description: A base64 private key. If not specified, it will be automatically generated upon interface creation.

public_key.description: A base64 public key is calculated from the private key.

block.description: Creates a Mikrotik interface wireguard only supported by RouterOS v7+.

allowed_address.description: List of IP (v4 or v6) addresses with CIDR masks from which incoming traffic for this peer is allowed and to which outgoing traffic for this peer is directed. The catch-all 0.0.0.0/0 may be specified for matching all IPv4 addresses, and ::/0 may be specified for matching all IPv6 addresses. Default: `""`.

comment.description: Short description of the peer. Default: `""`.

disabled.description: Boolean for whether or not the interface peer is disabled. Default: `false`.

endpoint_address.description: An endpoint IP or hostname can be left blank to allow remote connection from any address. Default: `""`.

endpoint_port.description: An endpoint port can be left blank to allow remote connection from any port. Default: `0`.

id.description: Identifier of this resource assigned by RouterOS

interface.description: Name of the WireGuard interface the peer belongs to.

persistent_keepalive.description: A seconds interval, between 1 and 65535 inclusive, of how often to send an authenticated empty packet to the peer for the purpose of keeping a stateful firewall or NAT mapping valid persistently. For example, if the interface very rarely sends traffic, but it might at anytime receive traffic from a peer, and it is behind NAT, the interface might benefit from having a persistent keepalive interval of 25 seconds. Default: `0`.

preshared_key.description: A base64 preshared key. Optional, and may be omitted. This option adds an additional layer of symmetric-key cryptography to be mixed into the already existing public-key cryptography, for post-quantum resistance. Default: `""`.

public_key.description: The remote peer's calculated public key.

block.description: Creates a Mikrotik Interface Wireguard Peer only supported by RouterOS v7+.

address.description: The IP address and netmask of the interface using slash notation.

comment.description: The comment for the IP address assignment.

interface.description: The interface on which the IP address is assigned.

block.description: Assigns an IP address to an interface.

address.description: The IPv6 address and prefix length of the interface using slash notation.

advertise.description: Whether to enable stateless address configuration. The prefix of that address is automatically advertised to hosts using ICMPv6 protocol. The option is set by default for addresses with prefix length 64. Default: `false`.

comment.description: The comment for the IPv6 address assignment.

disabled.description: Whether to disable IPv6 address. Default: `false`.

eui_64.description: Whether to calculate EUI-64 address and use it as last 64 bits of the IPv6 address. Default: `false`.

from_pool.description: Name of the pool from which prefix will be taken to construct IPv6 address taking last part of the address from address property. Default: `""`.

interface.description: The interface on which the IPv6 address is assigned.

no_dad.description: If set indicates that address is anycast address and Duplicate Address Detection should not be performed. Default: `false`.

block.description: Creates a MikroTik Ipv6Address.

comment.description: The comment of the IP Pool to be created.

next_pool.description: The IP pool to pick next address from if current is exhausted.

ranges.description: The IP range(s) of the pool. Multiple ranges can be specified, separated by commas: `172.16.0.6-172.16.0.12,172.16.0.50-172.16.0.60`.

block.description: Creates a Mikrotik IP Pool.

id.description: Identifier of this resource assigned by RouterOS

interval.description: Interval between two script executions, if time interval is set to zero, the script is only executed at its start time, otherwise it is executed repeatedly at the time interval is specified.

on_event.description: Name of the script to execute. It must exist `/system script`.

start_date.description: Date of the first script execution.

start_time.description: Time of the first script execution.

block.description: Creates a Mikrotik scheduler.

dont_require_permissions.description: If the script requires permissions or not. Default: `false`.

policy.description: What permissions the script has. This must be one of the following: ftp, reboot, read, write, policy, test, password, sniff, sensitive, romon.

source.description: The source code of the script. See the [MikroTik docs](https://wiki.mikrotik.com/wiki/Manual:Scripting) for the scripting language.

block.description: Creates a MikroTik Script.

disabled.description: Whether to create the interface in disabled state. Default: `false`.

interface.description: Name of physical interface on top of which VLAN will work. Default: `*0`.

vlan_id.description: Virtual LAN identifier or tag that is used to distinguish VLANs. Must be equal for all computers that belong to the same VLAN. Default: `1`.

block.description: Manages Virtual Local Area Network (VLAN) interfaces.
